title: The Japanese Rule To Lose Visceral Fat in 3 Weeks
summary: Doctor Mike Diamonds (a former medical doctor turned fitness coach) films in Japan and presents three Japanese cultural habits he frames as a way to lose visceral fat in three weeks. The three 'rules' are: (1) Hara Hachi Bu — eating to 80% fullness, supported by tactics like drinking green tea/matcha/sparkling water 20 minutes before meals, chewing 20-30 times, using chopsticks, and the PFC eating order (protein first, fiber second, carbs last); (2) Interval Walking Training — alternating 3 minutes fast and 3 minutes slow walking for 30 minutes; and (3) the Metabo Law — Japan's government-mandated waist-size measurement plus mandatory school nutrition education. The throughline is creating a 'natural Ozempic effect' by slowing eating and digestion so the brain registers fullness (which he says takes ~20 minutes). It is a health/lifestyle persuasion video citing some studies, not a rigorous scientific review, and it doubles as a funnel to his coaching program.
